# Steam Early Access Release Checklist — Deep Space Trader: Educational Frontier

> Generated 2026-07-19. This checklist tracks every step required for a Steam Early Access launch.
> Checkboxes marked `[x]` are verified complete. Unmarked `[ ]` remain to be done.

---

## 1. Pre-Launch — Account & Legal

- [ ] Register Steamworks developer account (partner.steamgames.com)
- [ ] Pay $100 Steamworks app registration fee
- [ ] Complete tax information (W-9 or equivalent)
- [ ] Set up payout method (bank account or PayPal)
- [ ] Accept Steam Subscriber Agreement
- [ ] Write Privacy Policy (GDPR + CCPA compliant)
- [ ] Write EULA (End User License Agreement)
- [ ] Write Refund Policy
- [ ] Complete ESRB rating questionnaire
- [ ] Complete PEGI rating questionnaire
- [ ] Apply for IARC rating
- [ ] Write accessibility conformance statement
- [ ] Register with data protection authority (if EU-based)

## 2. Pre-Launch — Store Page

- [x] Short description written (500 char max)
- [x] Long description written (5000 char max)
- [ ] Upload main capsule image (616×353)
- [ ] Upload small capsule (231×87)
- [ ] Upload header capsule (460×215)
- [ ] Upload hero capsule (1920×622)
- [ ] Upload library capsule (600×900)
- [ ] Upload library hero (3840×1240)
- [ ] Upload page background (1438×810)
- [x] 15 screenshots selected and prepared (1280×720 min)
- [ ] Upload 15 screenshots to Steamworks store page
- [ ] Set supported platforms: Windows
- [ ] Set minimum system requirements
- [ ] Set recommended system requirements
- [ ] Set languages: English
- [ ] Set price: $14.99 USD Early Access
- [ ] Set release date (TBD — Coming Soon)
- [ ] Set DRM: none
- [ ] Configure categories: Education, Indie, RPG, Simulation
- [ ] Configure tags: Educational, Science, Exploration, Open World, Space
- [ ] Configure Steam features: Single-player, Steam Achievements, Cloud Saves

## 2. Pre-Launch — Pricing & Business

- [x] Base price documented: $14.99 USD Early Access
- [ ] Confirm $14.99 after Steam 30% commission ($10.49 net)
- [ ] Set regional pricing (EU, UK, JP, etc.)
- [ ] Confirm launch discount (10-20% first week recommended)
- [ ] Set free demo price ($0.00, Coming Soon page)
- [ ] Configure launch discount dates

## 3. Build — Shipping Build Verification

- [x] Pipeline exit code: 0 (clean compile, cook, stage, package)
- [x] Shipping build packaged: 455MB
- [x] Chimera-Win64-Shipping.exe exists (173MB)
- [ ] Test Shipping build boots to main menu
- [ ] Test Shipping build loads deep_space_trader_demo_titan
- [ ] Test all 38 educational texts visible in Shipping build
- [ ] Test player movement (WASD + mouse) in Shipping build
- [ ] Test O2 HUD renders in Shipping build
- [ ] Test no crash within 15 minutes of gameplay
- [ ] Test save + load cycle
- [ ] Test windowed ↔ fullscreen toggle
- [ ] Test Alt+Tab focus loss/gain
- [ ] Verify memory usage < 4GB
- [ ] Verify framerate > 30fps on target hardware
- [ ] Build Linux version (`-platform=Linux`)
- [ ] Build Mac version (`-platform=Mac`)
- [ ] Test Steam Deck compatibility (Proton/SteamOS)

## 4. Build — Steamworks Integration

- [ ] Install Steamworks SDK
- [ ] Configure steam_appid.txt
- [ ] Integrate Steam Achievements (10 planned)
- [ ] Integrate Steam Cloud Saves
- [ ] Integrate Steam Rich Presence
- [ ] Integrate Steam Overlay
- [ ] Integrate Steam Input (controller mapping)
- [ ] Test all Steam integrations in Shipping build
- [ ] Create app depot in Steamworks
- [ ] Upload build to Steamworks depot
- [ ] Set depot manifest
- [ ] Create public and beta branches
- [ ] Run Steam build verification tool

## 5. Content — Educational Content Validation

- [x] 38 educational text actors placed in deep_space_trader_demo_titan
- [x] 41 educational item data assets on disk
- [x] 3 item categories: MineralSpecimen, AtmosphericData, AstronomicalData
- [x] Geology items (20): Basalt through Cryovolcanism — all placed
- [x] Meteorology items (13): Cirrus through Titan Atmosphere — all placed
- [x] Astronomy items (16): Stars through Tidal Locking — all placed
- [x] EDUCATIONAL_SOURCES.md created with 38 citations
- [x] Each item has real science description in Description field
- [ ] Verify every text is reachable by player on foot
- [ ] Verify no text clips through terrain or geometry
- [ ] Verify all 41 items can be collected (trigger zones)
- [ ] Verify item descriptions render correctly in UI
- [ ] Teacher guide written (printable PDF)
- [ ] Student worksheet written (printable PDF)

## 6. Content — Visual Environment

- [x] Orange tholin atmospheric haze configured (ExponentialHeightFog)
- [x] Methane lake created (water body)
- [x] Cryovolcano cone created (geometry)
- [x] Sky sphere with sunset lighting (17.5h)
- [x] TitanSurface landscape (4032×4032)
- [x] PlayerStart placed in level
- [ ] Saturn placed in sky as visible celestial body
- [ ] Terrain sculpted for canyon feel
- [ ] Rock material instances created
- [ ] Lighting build completed (Production quality)
- [ ] Star dome / celestial sphere placed
- [ ] Cloud layer refined (volumetric clouds)

## 7. Content — Screenshots & Media

- [x] 21 screenshots captured across demo_images/
- [x] Screenshots include: canyon wide, texts overview, sky sunset, rock formation, landscape
- [x] PIE gameplay screenshots captured (3, ~760KB each)
- [x] Titan environment screenshots (cryovolcano, methane lake, sunset)

- [ ] Add subtitles to trailer
- [ ] Upload trailer to YouTube (unlisted, then public on launch)
- [ ] Upload trailer to Steamworks store page
- [ ] Create 3 short GIFs (15s each) for Steam page

## 9. Marketing — Press Kit

- [ ] Developer bio written (200 words)
- [ ] Game description (one paragraph)
- [ ] Feature bullet list (10 features)
- [ ] 15 4K screenshots with callouts
- [ ] Vector logo (SVG + PNG)
- [ ] Capsule art variants (all Steam sizes)
- [ ] Fact sheet (one-page PDF)
- [ ] Press contact email: press@deepspacetrader.game
- [ ] Review code generation (20 Steam keys)
- [ ] Press kit hosted at https://deepspacetrader.game/press

## 10. Marketing — Curator & Influencer Outreach

- [ ] Identify 20 Steam Curators in education/science genre
- [ ] Send review codes to each curator via Curator Connect
- [ ] Contact 5 educational YouTube channels (SmarterEveryDay, SciShow, etc.)
- [ ] Contact 5 science education blogs
- [ ] Contact 3 gaming press outlets (PC Gamer, Rock Paper Shotgun, etc.)
- [ ] Write press release (wire distribution)
- [ ] Prepare FAQ for press inquiries

## 11. Marketing — Community & Social

- [ ] Create Twitter/X account: @DeepSpaceTrader
- [ ] Create YouTube channel
- [ ] Create Discord server (welcome, announcements, feedback, education)
- [ ] Create subreddit: r/DeepSpaceTrader
- [ ] Create Steam Community page

- [ ] Build wishlist target: 5,000 minimum (7,000 recommended)
- [ ] Plan Steam Next Fest participation (next available date)
- [ ] Plan launch announcement timing

## 12. Launch — Coming Soon Page

- [ ] Submit store page for Steam review
- [ ] Wait for Steam approval (1-5 business days)
- [ ] Respond to Steam feedback
- [ ] Publish Coming Soon page
- [ ] Enable wishlist functionality
- [ ] Verify wishlist button works on store page
- [ ] Post Coming Soon announcement on all social channels
- [ ] Monitor wishlist rate (target: >50/day)
- [ ] Adjust marketing if wishlist rate is below target

## 13. Launch — Final Steps

- [ ] Set firm Early Access release date
- [ ] Upload final build to Steamworks
- [ ] Run final Steam build verification
- [ ] Confirm launch discount settings
- [ ] Prepare hotfix capability (build pipeline verified)
